# Repeatable Holy Land & Mount Sinai endowment (60-month cooldown; real gold & tax-efficiency trade-off).
oe_red_dec_sinai_pilgrimage = {
    decision_category = expansion_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_red_participant = yes
        has_global_variable = oe_red_on
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 90
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_red_sinai_cd }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:clergy background = pop_type:nobles } }
    option = {
        name = oe_red_dec_sinai_pilgrimage.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -90
            add_religious_influence = 12
            add_prestige = 5
            set_variable = { name = oe_red_sinai_cd months = 60 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_red_sinai_endowment years = 10 mode = replace }
            oe_red_apply_byz_mam_bias = { bias = oe_red_b_holy_accord }
        }
    }
}

# One-time decision to finish & permanently charter Trajan's Canal at Suez if actor owns Suez.
oe_red_dec_trajan_canal_charter = {
    decision_category = infrastructure_decisions
    only_once = yes
    only_once_scope = country
    potential = {
        oe_red_participant = yes
        owns = location:suez
        current_year >= 1475
        location:suez = {
            NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_red_trajan_canal_open }
            NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_red_trajan_canal_fortified }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 300
        manpower >= 3
        stability >= 5
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:peasants } }
    option = {
        name = oe_red_dec_trajan_canal_charter.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -300
            add_manpower = -3
            add_stability = -4
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_canal_stage value = 3 }
            oe_red_clear_canal_works = yes
            location:suez = {
                add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_red_trajan_canal_open days = -1 mode = replace }
            }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_red_free_canal_charter years = 35 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}
